title: Two Ledgers, One Gate
summary: The fit act as a quiet chapter of the report, hung from the Index Spine. A statement and a muted light sentence ('Not for everyone. / We qualify first.') over the 48×2 red rule lead into two stacked hairline ledgers: Built for in ink and Not for as the muted sentence, each with one row open in place. The closing row puts the two doors exactly where the reader finishes qualifying themselves.

reference.borrowed: The report's Swiss chapter opener. A full-width top hairline, a huge index and name ('01 Tools') holding the left third, a title and short paragraph in the right two-thirds, and a mono list header ('In this chapter, we'll cover:') over short items on hairline rules. A full-width black bar CTA with an arrow closes the list, and much of the field is left empty on purpose.
reference.kelwin: The dithered photo is removed, and its space becomes the empty spine column. '01 Tools' becomes the spine index: a light 64px '09' over the red-square caps label '■ FIT', in cols 1–3 only. The top hairline becomes B's opening rule drawn from the spine, with the 6px square at the joint. The title and paragraph become an 88px sentence plus a muted light-weight sentence ('Not for everyone. / We qualify first.'), the founder's 48×2 red rule, an 18px body and a ruled side note. The single mono-headed list becomes two stacked ledgers ('Built for — we say yes when' / 'Not for — we decline when'), indexed N·01–N·06 continuously as one qualification. Each ledger hangs from the spine at a 7px joint square: solid for Built for, open for Not for, so the verdict is drawn in the spine's own vocabulary. Each row has a normal-width 24px title, a 17px descriptor and a hairline +, and Legora's accordion keeps exactly one row open per ledger. Not-for titles are set in --fg-2 and descriptors in --fg-3, so the second ledger reads as the muted sentence. The black bar CTA becomes the ledger's last row, with no box: 'Next · Sound like you?' then the red tracked-caps 'REQUEST A SYSTEM AUDIT ↗' and the underlined 'TALK TO THE TEAM →'. Red is limited to the label square, the rule and the primary door.

motion: entrance (long durations, short distances, --ease-out): the spine drops from the top edge into the joint (360ms), the 6px square lands, and the opening rule draws from the spine to the right margin (900ms). The '09' index and the '■ FIT' label fade in (400ms). The statement rises 12px (700ms), with the muted sentence 160ms behind, then the 48×2 red rule draws (600ms) and the body and side note rise. Each ledger's header fades in and its row rules draw top-down from the spine (600ms, 60ms stagger) as the indices, titles, descriptors and toggles fade in. The second ledger starts 300ms after the first.

the one moment, at ~2.2s: once both ledgers are drawn, the Not-for row N·06 'Lead-list shopping' opens in place (height + opacity, 360ms --ease-inout, + rotates to −), revealing why renting activity is declined. N·02 'Ready to own the system' rests open in the Built-for ledger.

interaction: rows open in place on click, one open per ledger. A hovered row fills --panel and its title shifts 8px right. The secondary link's underline draws from the left (300ms). On CTA hover the fill goes to --accent-hover and ↗ nudges up-right.

on the live site: the spine index is sticky and crossfades as sections pass. The timed open of N·06 happens once when the second ledger is in view. Reduced motion shows the final state with both rows open.
notes: The closed-row descriptors are short paraphrases of the source copy. The open rows carry the full source sentences plus one added line on ownership and one on lead-list buyers. The muted sentence was shortened from 'We qualify before we say yes.' Coherence pass (direction B, one site): every section now shares one head — 64px light index + red-square caps label (Mona 500, 11px, .18em) in the spine column, 88px statement at weight 430 / −0.018em with exactly one light (300) muted sentence, the 48×2 red rule, 18/30 lede — at 48/44/32px offsets from a 6px joint, with 128px top and bottom padding (the live site keeps B's 200px). Mono captions are 11px at .18em; spine numerals drop tabular figures (Mona's tabular zero is slashed); quiet doors are 12px tracked caps with a drawn arrow. Here: padding 136/96 → 128/128, head offsets to 48/44/32, label 11px, mono heads at .18em, CTAs 12px.
